data.one_liner: A framework for checking test expectations against values and building custom expectations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a literate API to express test expectations and build custom expectations. It allows checking values with descriptive failures, cascading assertions, and support for asynchronous values and streams.
use_when: You are writing unit or widget tests in Dart and want a literate expectation API.
You need to build custom expectations for your own types.
avoid_when: You are writing production code (this package is strictly for testing).
You rely on production use cases where experimental packages with frequent breaking changes are an issue.
strengths: Literate and readable API using cascade syntax and dot shorthands.
Robust support for asynchronous expectations and streams.
Clear failure reporting with detailed expectations.
weaknesses: Still experimental with a high expected rate of API and breaking changes.
For production use cases, package:test and package:matcher are recommended instead.
data.setup_notes: Add a dev_dependency on checks and import package:checks/checks.dart in your test code.
